title: AWS VPC (terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws)
description: Provision a VPC with subnets, route tables, internet gateway and NAT via ACK ec2. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws module (core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the VPC and its resources. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

name.title: name
name.description: Name to be used on all the resources as identifier.

cidr.title: cidr
cidr.description: The IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.

azs.title: azs
azs.description: A list of availability zones names in the region.

public_subnets.title: public_subnets
public_subnets.description: A list of public subnet CIDR blocks inside the VPC.

private_subnets.title: private_subnets
private_subnets.description: A list of private subnet CIDR blocks inside the VPC.

enable_nat_gateway.title: enable_nat_gateway
enable_nat_gateway.description: Should be true if you want to provision NAT Gateways for each of your private networks.

single_nat_gateway.title: single_nat_gateway
single_nat_gateway.description: Should be true if you want to provision a single shared NAT Gateway across all of your private networks.

enable_dns_hostnames.title: enable_dns_hostnames
enable_dns_hostnames.description: Should be true to enable DNS hostnames in the VPC.

enable_dns_support.title: enable_dns_support
enable_dns_support.description: Should be true to enable DNS support in the VPC.

map_public_ip_on_launch.title: map_public_ip_on_launch
map_public_ip_on_launch.description: Should be false if you do not want to auto-assign public IP on launch in public subnets.

instance_tenancy.title: instance_tenancy
instance_tenancy.description: A tenancy option for instances launched into the VPC.

create_igw.title: create_igw
create_igw.description: Controls if an Internet Gateway is created for public subnets.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.

public_subnet_tags.title: public_subnet_tags
public_subnet_tags.description: Additional tags for the public subnets.

private_subnet_tags.title: private_subnet_tags
private_subnet_tags.description: Additional tags for the private subnets.
